title: Notifications prompt
summary: After the person sends their first message, a sheet asks if they want to know when the reply comes. Allow opens the system permission; Not now closes the sheet for good on this phone.

recipientName.description: DM: the other person's name for the title. Missing in a group.

isAsking.description: true while the system permission dialog is open.

allow.effect: Opens the system permission dialog. Allowed: push-registration registers this phone. Either way the sheet closes and does not come back.

notNow.effect: Closes the sheet. It does not come back on this phone; the person can turn notifications on in notification-settings.

notes: Defined by registries/onboarding.json prompts, key notifications: trigger firstMessageSent, primary to systemPermission, text dismiss. Generated BipeOnboarding gives the keys; the app does not hard-code them.
Shows only when the system permission was never asked (push-registration permission notAsked). A phone that already allowed or denied never sees it.
Title: bipe_notifications_prompt_title with the name in a DM, bipe_notifications_prompt_title_generic in a group.
The sheet opens after the first message shows as sent, not while it sends, and never over another sheet.
Move, do not rewrite: the prompt trigger logic is generated from the registry into BipeKit and libraries/bipe (BipeOnboarding).
